info.name: Read all Fini conversations for your workspace, sorted newest first, with cursor pagination.

params.name: since
params.description: Start of the time window in Unix epoch milliseconds. Defaults to the last 7 days. The since/until window cannot exceed 90 days.

params.name: until
params.description: End of the time window in Unix epoch milliseconds. Defaults to the current time.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of conversations to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Conversation ID to paginate from. Pass the nextCursor or prevCursor from the previous response.

params.name: direction
params.description: Pagination direction. next moves to older conversations; previous moves toward newer ones (results are newest-first).

params.name: source
params.description: Optional comma-separated conversation sources (api, widget, ui, standalone, testsuite, replay, zendesk, intercom, front, hubspot, salesforce, gorgias, livechat, slack, discord, freshdesk, freshchat).
